family.name: Customer Support Executive
family.summary: The start of a shift with a mixed queue: spot the safety and fraud tickets under the shouting, handle a refund request outside policy, and fix a teammate’s reply that leaks another customer’s details.

stages.title: Warm-up
stages.summary: A 45-second spontaneous answer. Not scored; gives a voice sample to compare with later recordings.

stages.title: Which tickets first?
stages.summary: Order a mixed queue: safety and fraud tickets hidden among loud but low-risk ones, and one close to breaching its deadline. Think aloud.

stages.title: A return after the window
stages.summary: A loyal customer asks for a refund two days past the return window. Tests policy judgement and authority. Think aloud.

stages.title: The customer replies
stages.summary: The customer reacts to their choice. Tests calm, follow-through and honesty.

stages.title: Check a teammate's reply
stages.summary: A reply that leaks another customer's details, promises the wrong refund time and blames the courier. Think aloud.

stages.title: Reply to a long complaint (AI allowed)
stages.summary: Answer a multi-issue complaint with AI. Catches over-promising and padded apologies.

stages.title: A difficult customer
stages.summary: A real difficult customer they handled. Checks specificity and ownership.

brief.text: You're a support executive at **Glowkart**, a beauty and personal care app. Your shift starts at 9 am. These tickets are waiting for you.

brief.caption: Your queue at 9 am
rows: How do I change the delivery address on an order I placed this morning?
Suggestion: please add a wishlist sharing feature. Love the app otherwise!
I was charged twice for one order of ₹8,999. Both show in my bank statement.
WHERE IS MY ORDER??? WORST APP EVER. Placed it 2 days ago!!!
The face cream gave me a burning rash and swelling. A doctor told me to stop using it immediately.
I have 55k followers. My parcel is a day late. Reply in 1 hour or I post about you.
There’s an order on my account I didn’t place, delivered to an address I don’t know. My saved card was charged.
I asked to exchange a vitamin C serum for a different variant, for sensitive skin. Still waiting.

items: First reply within 24 hours on email and Instagram, 1 hour on chat.
Anything involving safety, injury, account security or fraud goes to the escalations team immediately.
Refunds reach the customer in 5 business days. Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery.
You can give goodwill credit of up to ₹500 without approval. Anything more needs your supervisor.

brief.text: The company and numbers are fictional, and every candidate gets a slightly different version. A calculator is fine.

prompt.text: What do you do when you don’t know the answer to a customer’s question?
Keep it under 45 seconds. This one is not scored; it just gets you talking.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

prompt.text: **Which four tickets do you handle first, in what order, and why?** Use the ticket numbers. Then say which ticket can safely wait the longest.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

choices.label: Politely decline: the return window has closed
Approve a full refund as goodwill
Offer store credit within your goodwill limit
Escalate to your supervisor to decide

prompt.text: A customer bought a vitamin C serum for ₹2,499. It was delivered 9 days ago, so the 7-day return window has closed. They say they were travelling and only opened it yesterday; it doesn't fit. They have placed 24 orders before and never returned anything.
**What do you do?** Pick one, then write the first two sentences of your reply.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Politely decline: the return window has closed"

prompt.text: The customer replies: "24 orders and this is how you treat me? Deleting the app." They've also posted a one-star review mentioning your name.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Approve a full refund as goodwill"

prompt.text: Your supervisor sees the refund in a daily report and asks you to explain why you approved ₹2,499 without approval, since your limit is ₹500.
**What do you say, and what do you do differently?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Offer store credit within your goodwill limit"

prompt.text: The customer says the credit is "useless, I just want my money back", and asks to speak to "someone senior". Your supervisor is in a meeting for the next two hours.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

variants.label: If they chose "Escalate to your supervisor to decide"

prompt.text: Your supervisor replies: "Busy today, use your judgement." Meanwhile the customer has messaged twice asking for an update.
**What do you do now?**

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

prompt.text: A new teammate asks you to check this reply to the double-charge ticket before sending. **Name the problems, worst first, and why each matters.** Then write your version.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

material.text: Hi! Sorry for the trouble 😊 This happened because the courier's payment system had a glitch, not our fault. I can see the same thing happened to Rohit Sharma (order #A-88213, rohit.s@mailbox.com) yesterday, so you're not alone! Your extra ₹8,999 will be back in your account within 24 hours. Have a great day!

stages.title: Reply to a long complaint (AI allowed)

prompt.text: Use any AI tool you like for this one. We are assessing how you use it, not whether you do.

A customer wrote 400 words: their order arrived late, one item was missing, the chat bot "went in circles", and they want compensation. Write the reply (under 150 words). Rules: refunds take 5 business days; your goodwill limit is ₹500.

items: Paste your full AI conversation, or write "none".
In 2–3 lines, say what you kept, changed or rejected from the AI and why.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.

prompt.text: **Tell us about a customer you found difficult to help, and what you did.** What did you see, what did you do, and what would you do differently?
Specifics such as numbers and timelines matter more than polish.

reviewerGuide.text: The answer key and rubric are hidden in the demo. Start free to see them for every role.
